findings.title: Controlled delivery proof chain did not close
findings.detail: Service result was saved before export_completed. Export chain raised ValueError, failure receipt says complete=false/END=false, then exception re-raised. CLI got HTTP500. Required trusted exports are absent and enclosing root witness is ineligible. File presence and service succeeded cannot earn controlled PASS.

findings.title: README facts are attached to non-supporting source lines
findings.detail: All six README fact citations fail their stated line support. Line6 is a true broad statement located elsewhere at README7; lines7-11 attach code facts to README HTML/badges/video. Other-source corroboration does not fix the submitted citations.

findings.title: Provider and logging statements exceed selected evidence
findings.detail: Line16 cites singleton construction for provider initialization/support; line17 cites Logger.debug for a compound debug/info assertion. Line18 faithfully points to a TODO comment but reads as an absolute only-Ollama limitation unless qualified; actual source48-51 has Gemini selection, and52-54 alone leaves OpenAI unimplemented. Do not erase the comment or infer provider runtime functionality.

findings.title: Research does not sufficiently answer architecture and open-source integration question
findings.detail: Three sections mostly list logs and timestamps. The fourth available source OpenJarvis native_react.py is unused; no supported account of its relation to Jarvis.ceo or existing execution substrate appears. Report omits the meaningful singleton/provider/tool-registry/query routing sequence visible in source and lacks integration boundaries. No claim of a proved Jarvis.ceo-to-OpenJarvis integration is justified by this corpus.

findings.title: Observed counters must retain their observation layer
findings.detail: CLI envelope has none of these work fields. Defaulted0/0/0/null are not evidence of no work. Independently read service result records search1 GET4 available4 cited3 and completed write effect; export-failure observer records native_POST_attempts5. These are distinct from unmeasured global native starts. Supplement correctly distinguishes them; no original receipt was changed.

fact_review.line_basis: 1-based raw splitlines of saved corpus source bodies; report lines are actual saved research.md. No regenerated report, rewritten claim, or added citation.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L1–L6，依据 L1–L4）Jarvis AI Assistant is an open-source project with a focus on local-capable and free usage.
claims.reason: README1-4 contains the logo and title only; raw1-6 excludes the openness/local/free statement.
claims.additional_context: README7 states all three properties, but is outside the supplied raw window and basis. Underlying project characterization is supported elsewhere, not by the cited lines.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L8–L15，依据 L10–L13）The project includes a unified agent that processes user queries using function calling for tool usage.
claims.reason: README10-13 are website/release/star badge links; no UnifiedAgent or function calling.
claims.additional_context: unified-agent.ts29-30 and43-48 describe conditional tool calling/text fallback. This context does not repair the report citation.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L3–L10，依据 L5–L8）The AgentManager class initializes the agent and supports multiple providers, including Ollama, with logging capabilities.
claims.reason: README5-8 contains the speaking tagline and local/open/free statement, not AgentManager, provider initialization or logging.
claims.additional_context: agent-manager.ts25-61 has provider selection and initialization;38-39 comment conflicts with Gemini branch48-51. No blanket support for all provider choices; OpenAI52-54 is unimplemented.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L8–L15，依据 L10–L13）The unified-agent.ts file includes methods for processing queries and logging information about the agent's operations.
claims.reason: README10-13 are badges, not methods or logging.
claims.additional_context: unified-agent.ts32-51 contains processing and logs, but is not the cited document.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L3–L10，依据 L5–L8）The project uses logging for debugging and informational purposes, including console.log and Logger.info statements.
claims.reason: README5-8 has marketing text/HTML, no console.log or Logger.info.
claims.additional_context: agent-manager.ts42-43 and unified-agent.ts60-70 contain examples, not the cited README.

claims.claim: - 文档说明（raw L17–L24，依据 L20–L20）The codebase includes a mechanism for tracking the time taken to process queries using Date.now().
claims.reason: README20 is a closing p tag; surrounding17-24 is a video URL/link and separator, not Date.now.
claims.additional_context: unified-agent.ts37,76-84,98-99 shows start/elapsed timestamps. Citation remains unsupported.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L20–L24，依据 L20–L20）The AgentManager class manages the initialization of the agent and supports multiple providers, including Ollama.
claims.reason: agent-manager.ts20 constructs singleton AgentManager;20-24 neither initializes UnifiedAgent nor selects providers.
claims.additional_context: 25-61 supports initialization with Ollama41-47 and Gemini48-51; OpenAI52-54 remains TODO. Multiple implemented selection branches exist, but imported provider implementations were not supplied and their functioning is not proved.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L28–L35，依据 L31–L31）The code includes logging for debugging and informational purposes, such as Logger.debug and Logger.info.
claims.reason: Line31 supports Logger.debug for skipping already-initialized agent. No Logger.info appears in28-35.
claims.additional_context: Logger.info exists43,50,61 elsewhere; cited evidence supports only the debug clause.

claims.claim: - 该处标注（raw L36–L43，依据 L39–L39）The code includes a limitation that only Ollama is currently supported, with plans to add OpenAI and Gemini providers.
claims.reason: The report labels this as a comment. Line39 really says TODO Add OpenAI and Gemini;38 calls Ollama the only fully implemented provider. Thus the comment attribution is supported. It does not prove a current runtime limitation that only Ollama is supported.
claims.additional_context: Actual code48-51 selects and constructs GeminiProvider;52-54 leaves OpenAI unimplemented. This nearby contradictory branch makes the absolute only-Ollama interpretation overbroad. The report does not reconcile this with its multi-provider claim.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L39–L43，依据 L42–L42）The code includes console.log statements for debugging, such as logging the creation of the OllamaProvider.
claims.reason: Line42 console.log logs creation of OllamaProvider with its model.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L40–L43，依据 L43–L43）The code includes Logger.info statements for logging the initialization of the Ollama provider.
claims.reason: Line43 Logger.info logs initialization with the Ollama provider/model.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L25–L29，依据 L25–L25）The unified-agent.ts file includes a Logger.info statement that logs the initialization of the agent with the provider and tool count.
claims.reason: Line25 Logger.info includes this.provider.name and this.toolRegistry.size.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L34–L41，依据 L37–L37）The code includes a Date.now() call to track the start time of query processing.
claims.reason: Line37 assigns Date.now() to startTime within processQuery.

claims.claim: - 代码观察（raw L37–L44，依据 L40–L40）The code includes a Logger.info statement that logs the processing of a user query, including the query content.
claims.reason: Line40 logs processing and query.substring(0,50) plus ellipsis. It includes a query excerpt, not necessarily the full query. The report does not explicitly claim full-query logging.

supplement_review.detail: Independently hashed supplement and six cited files, read original records and adapter plus agent_server.py1273-1282. Its layer distinction and unknown concrete export reason are supported. It grants no pass credit.

attribution_limits: Proved chain: submit returned service succeeded; adapter.py975 saved it;980 called export_completed;982 captured ValueError and983 rethrew. agent_server.py1273-1282 routes propagated exception to HTTP500. adapter.py583 then rejects missing request/session in CLI error envelope. This is a downstream identity mismatch, not proof that service used wrong identities.

Exact export failing function/subcondition/value and exception text are UNKNOWN_NOT_SAVED. export_completed includes packet verification, structure/decoded-value validation and member preservation; no basis to select regex, PII, schema field or report fact error as causal branch.

complete=false/END=false describes failed trusted export receipt. It does not establish that service never internally reached END/ACK. Complete independent END/ACK/replay/readback proof is unavailable.

Service search1/GET4 are saved controlled-harness observations, not real external-network validation. Export observer POST5 is application transport counter only; global native inference starts and OS packet totals remain null/unmeasured.
Provider comment and executable branch conflict must remain explicit; no imported Gemini/Ollama provider runtime verification was performed.
Seven identity equality and cleanup are saved point observations; no continuous liveness or historical Ollama launcher provenance is established. Reviewer performed no process inspection/control.
